questions.q: In which year did Trinidad and Tobago become independent?
questions.why: It became a republic in 1976.

questions.q: Who was the first Prime Minister of Trinidad and Tobago?
questions.why: He wrote 'Capitalism and Slavery'.

questions.q: Which explorer named Trinidad in 1498?
questions.why: He named it after the Holy Trinity.

questions.q: Which country ruled Trinidad before Britain took it in 1797?
questions.why: It became British under the 1802 treaty.

questions.q: Which workers came from India from 1845 after slavery ended?
questions.why: Over a third of the population has Indian roots.

questions.q: Who became the first woman Prime Minister, in 2010?
questions.why: She returned to the post in 2025.

questions.q: Which 1970 movement challenged the government?
questions.why: It was led by students and unions.

questions.q: Which labour leader led the 1937 oil workers' strike?
questions.why: Labour Day honours the strike.

questions.q: Which island joined with Trinidad as a colony in 1889?
questions.why: It is the smaller island.

questions.q: Which attempted coup took place in 1990?
questions.why: Parliament was held hostage.

questions.q: Which day on 1 August marks the end of slavery?
questions.why: Trinidad was the first country to make it a holiday.

questions.q: What is the capital of Trinidad and Tobago?
questions.why: It is in northwest Trinidad.

questions.q: Which natural lake of tar is in southern Trinidad?
questions.why: It is the world's largest natural asphalt deposit.

questions.q: Which bird sanctuary is famous for scarlet ibises?
questions.why: The scarlet ibis is a national bird.

questions.q: Which Tobago forest is the oldest protected rainforest in the Western Hemisphere?
questions.why: It was protected in 1776.

questions.q: Which Trinidadian writer wrote 'Beyond a Boundary' about cricket?
questions.why: It was published in 1963.

questions.q: Which sprinter won Olympic 100 m gold for Trinidad in 1976?
questions.why: It was the country's first Olympic gold.

questions.q: Which Trinidadian cricketer once held the Test record score of 400?
questions.why: He also scored 501 in a county match.

questions.q: Which javelin thrower won Olympic gold in 2012?
questions.why: He was only 19.

questions.q: Which upbeat music style grew from calypso?
questions.why: Its name comes from 'soul of calypso'.

questions.q: Which calypsonian known as 'The Mighty Sparrow' won many crowns?
questions.why: He is called the Calypso King of the World.

questions.q: Which hip-hop star was born in Trinidad?
questions.why: She moved to New York as a child.

questions.q: Which writer from Trinidad won the 2001 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.why: He wrote 'A House for Mr Biswas'.

questions.q: Which festival before Lent is Trinidad's biggest celebration?
questions.why: It is one of the world's greatest carnivals.

questions.q: Which day on 30 May marks the arrival of Indian labourers?
questions.why: The first ship was the Fatel Razack.

questions.q: Which musical instrument was invented in Trinidad?
questions.why: It was made from oil drums.

questions.q: Which street food is curried chickpeas in fried bread?
questions.why: It is a favourite breakfast.

questions.q: What is Trinidad and Tobago's currency?
questions.why: Its code is TTD.

questions.q: Which sandwich of fried fish in bread is famous at Maracas Bay?
questions.why: It is topped with sauces.

questions.q: Which Muslim festival in Trinidad commemorates Hussein with colourful tombs?
questions.why: It has Indian Shia roots.
